description: Itinéraires découverte des repères de crue is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Toulouse métropole. Pedestrian routes to discover the flood markers located in the city of Toulouse. Coverage: Toulouse métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Itineraries discovery of flood markers" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Toulouse métropole. Its keywords include patrimoine, itineraire, crue. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-05-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
